assumptions.early_signal: EMA spread<0 and expands for 3 bars; close below the previous 20-bar low; -DI > 2*+DI; ADX28>=30, rises for 3 bars and delta3>=1; volume/MA192>=3; exclude bars already accepted by the normal V35.3 signal.
assumptions.execution: Early K0 close signal, skip K1, open satellite at K2. A normal V35.3 short signal observed within the confirmation window schedules the add at its K2 open.
assumptions.sizing: Primary opens 25% of the normal planned allocation. At confirmation, add up to the normal K2 planned total.
assumptions.satellite_exit: Primary uses an entry-ATR 2.0 stop-market with gap-aware open fill. If no normal short signal appears within 4 completed bars, exit at the next open.
assumptions.confirmed_exit: After add, use weighted entry price and the confirming K1 ATR; then V35.3 short MFE4.4 reduce75%, TP5/SL5.7.
assumptions.costs: 0.00085 per filled allocation plus Binance funding.
assumptions.selection: Primary parameters came from the prior user-approved proposal. Stop 1.5/2.5, window 2/6, and fraction 12.5%/50% are audit-only sensitivity variants.
